commit aa61062ac140317d0ba9b3f12850a2dca43d0b4f
Author: Rishi Kumar <r-kumar12@ti.com>
Date:   Fri May 22 14:51:10 2026 +0530

    allsoc: enet_icss: fix HSR preemption queue MSMC end address overflow in Switch mode
    
    hostEgressPreQueueSize for Switch mode preemption queues was set to
    ICSSG0/1_PRE_QUEUE_TOTAL_SIZE (total pool size) instead of
    ICSSG_SWITCH_HOST_QUEUE_SIZE (per-queue size), causing the firmware to
    compute an MSMC end address 20KB beyond the actual buffer pool boundary.
    This led to buffer descriptor corruption when HSR preemption queues were
    enabled. Fix by using ICSSG_SWITCH_HOST_QUEUE_SIZE consistent with the
    express queue configuration.
    
    Fixes: SITREQ-6787 PINDSW-10928
    
    Signed-off-by: Rishi Kumar <r-kumar12@ti.com>

commit c7da27ef754c6537986dc8799b129aa0b978a0e3
Author: thilak <t-karanam@ti.com>
Date:   Fri Jul 3 13:14:01 2026 +0530

    am243x: ENET: Fix Linker commands for enet_lwip_https
    
    - Fix MSRAM ORIGIN in example.syscfg from 0x70000000 to 0x70080000 so the
      application is placed above the SBL reserved region (0x70000000-0x70080000),
      preventing the app from corrupting the running SBL during UART boot loading
    - Reduce MSRAM LENGTH from 0x190000 to 0x160000 to fit within the available
      window between the SBL boundary and the DMSC reservation at 0x701E0000
    - Mark MSRAM as a manual (non-auto) region with explicit start address so
      SysConfig does not silently reset the origin on regeneration
    - Remove stale hand-edited ti-arm-clang/linker.cmd; the build exclusively
      uses SysConfig-generated generated/linker.cmd, making this file misleading
    
    Fixes: SITSW-12354
    
    Signed-off-by: Thilak <t-karanam@ti.com>

commit aa7f97cf3e118967f60014fb30ec7c245213b05d
Author: Archit Dev <a-dev@ti.com>
Date:   Mon Jul 6 14:33:42 2026 +0530

    am243x/am64x: sysconfig: fix perMode for non-HSR/PRP protocols
    
    - The dma_init_config.c.xdt and enet_init_udma.c.xdt templates set
    perMode = ENET_UDMA_ICSSG_LRE_TX_OFFLOAD_ENABLE for any non-NONE
    derivedMode, including ETHERNETIP. This is incorrect.
    
    - ENET_UDMA_ICSSG_LRE_TX_OFFLOAD_ENABLE forces dstTag to 0 in the
    TX submission path (enet_udma_priv.c), overriding any directed-port
    configuration set by the application.
    
    - Since LRE TX offload (ENABLE) is only applicable to HSR and PRP protocols
    fix the condition in both templates to only set ENABLE for HSR/PRP.
    
    Fixes: PINDSW-11240
    
    Signed-off-by: Archit Dev <a-dev@ti.com>

commit 255a5951c84cbb0ac1331cac00de030a34ef1048
Author: thilak <t-karanam@ti.com>
Date:   Wed Jul 8 14:37:04 2026 +0530

    allsocs: enet: Simplfy enet_cpsw_socket example scope
    
    - Simplify the enet_cpsw_socket example scope to avoid
      read, write race condition.
    - Previously, the select monitors both read and write fds
      and if echo arrives later, the thread writes second msg
      and closes the socket, causing the client socket to miss
      the echoed message.
    - This change reduces the scope so that select montiors only
      read fd and closes socket as soon as echo arrives.
    - This also changes the license headers of the files.
    
    Fixes: SITSW-12232
    
    Signed-off-by: Thilak <t-karanam@ti.com>

commit 841baa2590ee1b71fc2df13912bd4991870e56b0
Author: thilak <t-karanam@ti.com>
Date:   Wed Jul 8 12:15:36 2026 +0530

    am275x: enet: Fix Endianness in aafpcm_audio applications
    
    - shm_cirbuf: Add shm_bswap_write() and shm_bswap_read() to shm_cirbuf
      in both aafpcm_audio_demo and aafpcm_audio_etherring_demo; these
      byte-swap each 16- or 32-bit element in-place during the SHM transfer,
      avoiding a separate pass over the buffer
    - shm_cirbuf: Add shm_swap32() / shm_swap16() static inline helpers and
      shm_bswap_width enum (SHM_BSWAP_16BIT / SHM_BSWAP_32BIT) to support
      the new bswap APIs
    - autoamp_avb, central_aaf_app: Replace shm_read() with shm_bswap_read()
      in the Talker path to convert little-endian McASP samples to big-endian
      as required by IEEE 1722 before transmission
    - autoamp_avb, central_aaf_app: Replace shm_write() with shm_bswap_write()
      in the Listener path to convert big-endian IEEE 1722 payload samples to
      little-endian before writing to the McASP SHM ring buffer
    - autoamp_avb, central_aaf_app: Add 4-byte-aligned gRxPduBuf[] and copy
      the unaligned AVTP payload pointer into it before passing to
      gpio_sm_spin(), which requires 4-byte-aligned input
    - autoamp_avb, central_aaf_app: Mark gTxCopyBuffer with
      __attribute__((aligned(4))) to satisfy alignment requirements of the
      bswap read path
    
    Fixes: SITSW-11331
    
    Signed-off-by: Thilak <t-karanam@ti.com>

commit 5f831e2ff3ed8cef272b2df48003c74aee60672a
Author: Siddharth S <s-s9@ti.com>
Date:   Mon Aug 17 16:35:54 2026 +0530

    enet: Fix Klocwork issues for 11.2.2
    
    - EnetAppUtils_printSGFrame, EnetUdma_processRetrievedDesc, and
      EnetUdma_submitPkts iterate sgList.list[] up to numScatterSegments.
    - Runtime value not statically bounded by the array's declared size
      (ENET_UDMA_CPSW_MAX_SG_LIST).
    - Existing guard is a zero-index check, which Klocwork correctly
      flags as insufficient to prevent an out-of-bounds index
      if numScatterSegments ever exceeds the array capacity.
    - Loop index should be bound against ENET_UDMA_CPSW_MAX_SG_LIST in
      each function before it is used to index sgList.list[] / hostBufDesc[],
      so behavior is unchanged for valid segment counts and safely capped
      otherwise.
    
    Fixes: ETHFW-3691
    Signed-off-by: Siddharth S <s-s9@ti.com>

Date:   Thu Aug 20 00:41:35 2026 +0530

    enet: examples: add tsn_demo_talker (am261x-lp, am261x-som)
    
    Talker generates a periodic "express" probe stream (paced by a plain
    SysConfig RTI timer, CONFIG_TIMER0) and a saturating "bulk" background
    stream, receives echoes back from the listener chain, and computes
    one-way / round-trip latency, jitter (PDV) and loss into fixed-bin
    histograms - with and without EST/IET/cut-through, so the two runs can
    be compared side by side from the UART menu.

    orchestration (baseline / contention-off / contention-on), console.
    - tsndemo_pacing.c: RTI-timer-driven tick callback for the express
    generator.
    - tsndemo_stats.c: fixed-bin latency histograms and report printing.
    
    Fixes: MCUSDK-15794
    
    Signed-off-by: Ranga Rakesh Jonnalagadda <r-jonnalagadda@ti.com>
